validation_scope: MCDA robustness, rank stability, criterion sensitivity and retrospective temporal validation
final_interpretation: The CRITIC-TOPSIS cooling-priority framework is highly robust to sampling variation and reasonable weight uncertainty. Retrospective one-year backtesting provides moderate positive temporal support, with higher-priority grids showing substantially higher subsequent observed heat burden. Exact hottest-grid overlap is moderate because the priority framework combines heat with trend, green deficit, built-up pressure, blue-space deficit and modeled intervention benefit rather than acting as a pure heat-ranking model.
